title: Woven Gold Hoops
category: Earrings (chunky braided hoop, sold as 1 pair)
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18K gold coating over surgical stainless steel), mirror-polished wires and disc
lock: 2 round hoops, 25 mm across, each a 5-6 mm open plait: polished round wires laid in pairs, braided in chevrons over a see-through core of finer wires. 1 flat 8 mm disc at the top on the latch side, 1 thin hinged latch wire, 0 stones, no bottom loop. 18k gold tone, mirror polish. Must stay a many-wire open braid, never a smooth tube, simple twist or oval.
morph: The braid. Image models smooth it into a plain tube or a simple 2-strand twisted rope, close up the see-through gaps, or drop the flat disc. Scale also drifts to 1.4-1.5x and the hoop goes oval (listing photo 04 itself reads oval and about 1.3x), and an earlier take invented a loop at the bottom.
sizeMm: Approximately 25 mm across, give or take 1 mm (listing description and size-guide photo 07). Estimated from photo 07: braid about 5-6 mm thick, flat disc about 8 mm. Worn, it hangs from the lobe at about half the ear's height (photo 05; the earlier reel measured 22-26 mm worn), a little smaller than a Rs 10 coin (27 mm).
mediaIdSource: Reused from ads-500 products.md (pack, detail). 01.jpg and 03.jpg are the same photos as ads-500/build/refs/woven-gold-hoops__pack.jpg and __detail.jpg (same size, mean pixel difference under 1/255).
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, 18k gold tone, stock 88. Every product photo shows this tone; there is no rhodium silver tone option. Show the pair.
story: Texture does the talking: a mid-size 25 mm hoop that reads rich from across a room because every polished wire catches its own highlight, and intricate up close because you can see through the open plait. No stones, just weight and ridge-and-shadow. It rhymes with a plain white shirt or kurta, a low bun or loose hair, and a bare neckline (the listing's own styling tip), and with day-to-night wear since it is waterproof.
copyNotes: Use: 18k gold tone, PVD 18k gold tone, braided, woven texture, chunky, ridge and shadow, 25 mm, surgical stainless steel, waterproof, tarnish free, hypoallergenic. Avoid: 'gold' or '18k gold' without 'tone', 'solid gold'; 'Woven Gold' without 'tone' in body copy (title is fine); 'anti-tarnish' (say tarnish free); huggie; twist/twisted rope; rope chain; any stone word (CZ, crystal, diamond); oval; any size other than 25 mm; weave puns (wheat ears, paranda, choti were dropped by the founder).

photos.shows: Packshot: the pair on a white plaster block, cream backdrop. One hoop stands showing the hinge knuckle, latch wire and flat disc; the other lies on its side showing the chevron braid profile. 18k gold tone. Reference 1.
Campaign still: the pair on a glossy wet burgundy dome with water drops, NAIRA wordmark top left and flower mark bottom right. 18k gold tone. Has text overlay; not a reference.

Detail: one hoop standing against the block, front face with disc and hinge, the open braid and its inner core of finer wires clearly visible; the second hoop lies on the block behind. 18k gold tone. Reference 2.
Worn close-up on the ear against dark hair and a cream collar. The hoop reads oval and about 1.3x true size (about half the ear's height, narrow). Do not use for scale.
Worn street shot: low bun, white shirt, pale building facade, fingers at the jaw. Hoop reads round and close to true size. Best worn scale photo if a worn reference is needed.
Packaging: blush Naira Petite gift box with rose petals. No product.
Size guide: one hoop with a 25 mm bar and a 10 mm ruler, text 'Hoop 25 mm across'. Scale evidence; text overlay, so not a generation reference.
